olivia: quick bakeoff summary — ran GPTQ (4-bit), AWQ (4-bit), INT8, and FP8 proxies across Llama-2-7b, Mistral-7b, and Qwen-7b on our numeracy suite (GSM8K few-shot, MultiArith subset, and a custom calculation prompt set). posting numbers and an ops-ready recommendation. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

raj: nice — can you paste the deltas vs fp16?

olivia: short table (all deltas are relative to fp16 baseline, +/- points):
- Llama-2-7b: GPTQ-4: GSM8K -6.4, MMLU -2.1, MultiArith -7.9; AWQ-4: GSM8K -5.1, MMLU -1.9, MultiArith -6.8; INT8: GSM8K -3.2, MMLU -0.9, MultiArith -3.9
- Mistral-7b: GPTQ-4: GSM8K -4.0, MMLU -1.7, MultiArith -4.6; AWQ-4: GSM8K -3.6, MMLU -1.2, MultiArith -3.9; INT8: GSM8K -2.0, MMLU -0.6, MultiArith -2.1
- Qwen-7b: GPTQ-4: GSM8K -8.7, MMLU -3.8, MultiArith -9.5; AWQ-4: GSM8K -7.1, MMLU -3.2, MultiArith -7.8; INT8: GSM8K -4.5, MMLU -1.4, MultiArith -4.9

marta: interesting that Qwen degrades a lot under GPTQ-4. did you hold kv-cache config same as fp16?

olivia: yes — same sequence length and kv layout. noticed on Qwen we get token mismatch in the middle of long arithmetic chains ~40 tokens in. instrumented outputs show the kv attenuations are off. added a small repro in the gist: https://short.link/qwen-kv-repro

raj: hypothesis — GPTQ quantization had per-layer clip points tuned for generation head, but Qwen's rotary+kv fusion sensitive for accumulation. AWQ preserves accumulation behavior better (less headwise scale error).

olivia: experiment notes:
- All runs used our standard eval harness with deterministic sampling for GSM8K and 8-shot prompts.
- For GPTQ we used the canonical per-channel 4-bit config with fine-tuned calibration (1000 calibration samples).
- AWQ used default heuristics + per-block bias correction where available.
- INT8 used symmetric per-tensor quant and per-channel for linear layers where supported.

kai: ops question — if we pick AWQ for Mistral and INT8 for Llama, any special rollout flags?

marta: yes: for AWQ/Mistral recommended profile:
```
- batch_size: 1 (latency-critical)
- kv_cache: enabled (use 32-bit accumulation if available)
- model_variant: awq-4-stable (our build tag)
- fallback: int8-lower-precision if OOM
- rollout: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automatic quality check on GSM8K quick probe
```

raj: operational caveat — for Llama INT8, set batch_size 2 and enable prefix-caching to avoid throughput drop. GPTQ-4 should be limited to non-numeracy surfaces or short-context features for Qwen unless we backport per-layer clip corrections.

olivia: perf notes: AWQ often matches GPTQ latency within ~5% and reduces memory by ~28% vs fp16 on the same GPU. INT8 gives best memory but sometimes needs extra kernel tuning.

olivia: recommended immediate actions:
1) For Mistral-7b: roll AWQ-4 to dedicated pool with canary and GSM8K quick probe. (reason: stable numeracy, low regression risk)
2) For Llama-2-7b: prefer INT8 for production text-heavy use; reserve GPTQ-4 for experiments due to small accuracy hits but good size tradeoff.
3) For Qwen-7b: hold GPTQ-4 off production for numeracy workloads; try AWQ-4 + per-layer bias-correction sweep, and run an extended calibration set (10k samples) before any rollout.
4) Implement a small unit eval (20 short GSM8K prompts) in the canary path with automatic rollback if accuracy drops >3 pts.

marta: ops checklist for the rollout PR? I can make a template.

olivia: please include these items: kv-accum config, per-layer quant metadata, calibration seed, and the quick GSM8K probe. also add a smoke test for arithmetic chain length 60 tokens.

raj: also log layerwise activation histograms for 5% canary traffic — helps catch drift early.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment at 2024-08-12T15:00:00Z for pool "quant-awq-mistral-7b". :robot_face:

kai: thanks — I'll create the dedicated pool and attach the monitoring rule. ping me once PR is up.

olivia: PR reference will be posted here when ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
